podcast.title: Parallel Project by Servando Carballar (1980)
podcast.body: Servando Carballar established Los Iniciados in 1980 as a parallel group to Aviador Dro. The band distinguished itself by always performing with hidden identities. "En 1980, Servando Carvallero montó un grupo paralelo a aviador drogo, los cuales actuaban siempre con identidades o cultas."

srcs.episode: La España Siniestra ｜ La edad de oro del Postpunk y el Dark wave

podcast.title: Alleged Alphaville Involvement
podcast.body: It is believed that Los Iniciados included members from Alphaville, another group that explored darker themes in their music, adding to the enigmatic nature of the project. "y se supone que contaba conviembros de la banda alfabil, otro grupo que coqueteó con los curos."

srcs.episode: La España Siniestra ｜ La edad de oro del Postpunk y el Dark wave

podcast.title: Core Member Marta Cervera
podcast.body: The group's core revolved around Marta Cervera, known as Arcoíris, highlighting her central role in the project. "La base del grupo giron torno a Marta Cerbera, Arcoides."
